S.FORM: == Kakorot 野苦瓜 == takaray a sowal o kakorot hananay i, ira ko nipaloma'an ira ko rengaw sanay i taliyok no loma' ato palapalaan. yo itiraay i taliyok no loma' a kakorot i,o tayaling han nita a pangangan, nawhan matiya o tayaling to tosiya a nengnengen sa pangangan han to tayalin. nikawrira mamamamangay cowa ka tata'ang, malecaday toya nipalomaan a 'angrer.
S.PHON: kak[o|u]r[o|u]t *** takaraj a s[o|u]waɾ [o|u] kak[o|u]r[o|u]t ħananaj i ira k[o|u] nipaɾ[o|u]maʡan ira k[o|u] rəŋaw sanaj i taɾij[o|u]k n[o|u] ɾ[o|u]maʡ at[o|u] paɾapaɾaan j[o|u] itiraaj i taɾij[o|u]k n[o|u] ɾ[o|u]maʡ a kak[o|u]r[o|u]t i[o|u] tajaɾiŋ ħan nita a paŋaŋan nawħan matija [o|u] tajaɾiŋ t[o|u] t[o|u]sija a nəŋnəŋən sa paŋaŋan ħan t[o|u] tajaɾin nikawrira mamamamaŋaj ʦ[o|u]wa ka tataʡaŋ maɾəʦa[ɬ|ɮ]aj t[o|u]ja nipaɾ[o|u]maan a ʡaŋrər
